name: Personalization_Bench_w_dpa
description: A benchmark for measuring model ability to personalize outputs to individual users or contexts, typically by adapting responses or recommendations based on private or historical user data. It evaluates how well models can incorporate personal attributes or preferences while preserving privacy-aware constraints. Tasks often include personalization ranking, classification, and generation across text-based interactions.
evaluation_method: ranking metrics (e.g., NDCG/Recall@k) and accuracy for classification tasks
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset focused on personalization research with limited but growing use in specialized personalization experiments.
